from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, ForeignKey, String, Text, BigInteger, DateTime, Enum
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, declarative_base
from datetime import datetime
import enum

Base = declarative_base()

class SubscriptionType(enum.Enum):
    ru = "ru"
    eu = "eu"

class SubscriptionStatus(enum.Enum):
    active = "active"
    expired = "expired"
    blocked = "blocked"

class Subscription(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'subscriptions'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = Column(ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)
    type = Column(Enum(SubscriptionType), nullable=False)
    status = Column(Enum(SubscriptionStatus), default=SubscriptionStatus.active)
    start_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    expiry_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    traffic_limit = Column(BigInteger, nullable=True)
    traffic_used = Column(BigInteger, default=0)
    panel_uuid = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    inbound_tag = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    link = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    
    user = relationship("User", backref="subscriptions")
    
    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == SubscriptionStatus.active and datetime.utcnow() < self.expiry_date

from sqlalchemy import Column, String, Text, DateTime
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class Settings(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'settings'
    
    key = Column(String(255), primary_key=True)
    value = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    @classmethod
    async def get(cls, session, key: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
        from sqlalchemy import select
        result = await session.execute(select(cls).where(cls.key == key))
        row = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        return row.value if row else default
    
    @classmethod
    async def set(cls, session, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        from sqlalchemy import select, update
        result = await session.execute(select(cls).where(cls.key == key))
        row = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if row:
            await session.execute(update(cls).where(cls.key == key).values(value=value, updated_at=datetime.utcnow()))
        else:
            session.add(cls(key=key, value=value))

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select
from src.models.user import User
from typing import Optional

class UserRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
    
    async def get_by_telegram_id(self, telegram_id: int) -> Optional[User]:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(User).where(User.telegram_id == telegram_id))
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
    
    async def create(self, telegram_id: int, username: str | None = None) -> User:
        user = User(telegram_id=telegram_id, username=username)
        self.session.add(user)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(user)
        return user
    
    async def get_or_create(self, telegram_id: int, username: str | None = None) -> User:
        user = await self.get_by_telegram_id(telegram_id)
        if not user:
            user = await self.create(telegram_id, username)
        return user

from aiogram import Router, F
from aiogram.types import CallbackQuery, Message
from aiogram.filters import Command
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select
from datetime import datetime

router = Router()

@router.callback_query(F.data == "my_subscription")
@router.message(Command("my"))
async def show_subscription(event: CallbackQuery | Message, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
    from src.models.subscription import Subscription, SubscriptionStatus
    from src.models.user import User
    
    telegram_id = event.from_user.id
    
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Subscription)
        .join(User)
        .where(User.telegram_id == telegram_id)
        .where(Subscription.status == SubscriptionStatus.active)
        .order_by(Subscription.expiry_date.desc())
    )
    subscription = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    
    if not subscription:
        text = "❌ У вас нет активной подписки.\n\nИспользуйте /buy для покупки."
    else:
        days_left = (subscription.expiry_date - datetime.utcnow()).days
        traffic_used = subscription.traffic_used or 0
        traffic_limit = subscription.traffic_limit or float('inf')
        
        text = (
            f"✅ Ваша подписка активна\n\n"
            f"🌍 Тип: {'🇷🇺 Россия' if subscription.type == 'ru' else '🇪🇺 Европа'}\n"
            f"📅 Истекает: {subscription.expiry_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')}\n"
            f"⏳ Осталось дней: {days_left}\n"
            f"📊 Трафик: {traffic_used / 1024 / 1024 / 1024:.2f} GB"
        )
        
        if subscription.link:
            text += f"\n\n🔗 Ваша ссылка:\n`{subscription.link}`"
    
    if isinstance(event, CallbackQuery):
        await event.message.edit_text(text)
    else:
        await event.answer(text)

import aiohttp
from aiohttp import BasicAuth
from typing import Optional
import os
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential

class ThreeXUIClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = os.getenv("PANEL_3XUI_URL")
        self.auth = BasicAuth(
            login=os.getenv("PANEL_3XUI_USER"),
            password=os.getenv("PANEL_3XUI_PASS")
        )
    
    @retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=2, max=10))
    async def get_inbounds(self) -> list:
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(auth=self.auth) as session:
            async with session.get(f"{self.base_url}/panel/api/inbounds/list") as resp:
                resp.raise_for_status()
                data = await resp.json()
                return data.get('obj', [])
    
    @retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=2, max=10))
    async def add_client(self, inbound_id: int, email: str, uuid: str, expiry_time: int, traffic_limit: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
        client_config = {
            "id": uuid,
            "email": email,
            "flow": "xtls-rprx-vision",
            "limitIp": 0,
            "totalGB": traffic_limit or 0,
            "expiryTime": expiry_time,
            "enable": True,
            "tgId": "",
            "subId": ""
        }
        
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(auth=self.auth) as session:
            async with session.post(
                f"{self.base_url}/panel/api/inbounds/addClient",
                json={"id": inbound_id, "settings": client_config}
            ) as resp:
                resp.raise_for_status()
                data = await resp.json()
                return data.get('success', False)
    
    @retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=2, max=10))
    async def get_client_traffic(self, email: str) -> int:
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(auth=self.auth) as session:
            async with session.get(f"{self.base_url}/panel/api/inbounds/getClientTraffic/{email}") as resp:
                resp.raise_for_status()
                data = await resp.json()
                obj = data.get('obj', {})
                return obj.get('up', 0) + obj.get('down', 0)

from apscheduler.schedulers.asyncio import AsyncIOScheduler
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

async def check_expiring_subscriptions(session: AsyncSession, bot) -> None:
    from src.models.subscription import Subscription, SubscriptionStatus
    from src.models.user import User
    
    now = datetime.utcnow()
    
    # Найти подписки, истекающие через 3 дня
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Subscription, User)
        .join(User)
        .where(Subscription.status == SubscriptionStatus.active)
        .where(Subscription.expiry_date <= now + timedelta(days=3))
        .where(Subscription.expiry_date > now)
    )
    
    for subscription, user in result.all():
        days_left = (subscription.expiry_date - now).days
        try:
            await bot.send_message(
                user.telegram_id,
                f"⚠️ Ваша подписка истекает через {days_left} дн.\n\n"
                f"Используйте /renew для продления."
            )
            logger.info(f"Reminder sent to {user.telegram_id}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to send reminder: {e}")

async def check_expired_subscriptions(session: AsyncSession) -> None:
    from src.models.subscription import Subscription, SubscriptionStatus
    
    now = datetime.utcnow()
    
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Subscription)
        .where(Subscription.status == SubscriptionStatus.active)
        .where(Subscription.expiry_date <= now)
    )
    
    for subscription in result.scalars().all():
        subscription.status = SubscriptionStatus.expired
        logger.info(f"Subscription {subscription.id} marked as expired")
    
    await session.commit()

def setup_scheduler(scheduler: AsyncIOScheduler, session_maker, bot) -> None:
    scheduler.add_job(
        check_expiring_subscriptions,
        'interval',
        hours=1,
        args=[session_maker, bot],
        id='check_expiring'
    )
    scheduler.add_job(
        check_expired_subscriptions,
        'interval',
        hours=1,
        args=[session_maker],
        id='check_expired'
    )

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

async def sync_traffic_3xui(session: AsyncSession, client_3xui) -> None:
    from src.models.subscription import Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, SubscriptionType
    
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Subscription)
        .where(Subscription.type == SubscriptionType.ru)
        .where(Subscription.status == SubscriptionStatus.active)
        .where(Subscription.panel_uuid != None)
    )
    
    for subscription in result.scalars().all():
        try:
            traffic = await client_3xui.get_client_traffic(subscription.panel_uuid)
            subscription.traffic_used = traffic
            
            if subscription.traffic_limit and traffic >= subscription.traffic_limit:
                subscription.status = SubscriptionStatus.blocked
                logger.info(f"Subscription {subscription.id} blocked (traffic exceeded)")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to sync traffic for {subscription.id}: {e}")
    
    await session.commit()

async def sync_traffic_hiddify(session: AsyncSession, client_hiddify) -> None:
    from src.models.subscription import Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, SubscriptionType
    
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Subscription)
        .where(Subscription.type == SubscriptionType.eu)
        .where(Subscription.status == SubscriptionStatus.active)
        .where(Subscription.panel_uuid != None)
    )
    
    for subscription in result.scalars().all():
        try:
            user_data = await client_hiddify.get_user(subscription.panel_uuid)
            traffic_used = user_data.get('data_used', 0)
            subscription.traffic_used = traffic_used
            
            if subscription.traffic_limit and traffic_used >= subscription.traffic_limit:
                subscription.status = SubscriptionStatus.blocked
                logger.info(f"Subscription {subscription.id} blocked (traffic exceeded)")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to sync traffic for {subscription.id}: {e}")
    
    await session.commit()

import logging
import sys
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
import os

def setup_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> None:
    os.makedirs('logs', exist_ok=True)
    
    formatter = logging.Formatter(
        '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
        datefmt='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
    )
    
    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    
    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(
        'logs/bot.log',
        maxBytes=10*1024*1024,
        backupCount=5
    )
    file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    
    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
    root_logger.setLevel(level)
    root_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
    root_logger.addHandler(file_handler)
    
    logging.getLogger('aiohttp').setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    logging.getLogger('sqlalchemy').setLevel(logging.WARNING)

from typing import Optional

def generate_vless_link(
    uuid: str,
    server: str,
    port: int,
    sni: str,
    public_key: str,
    short_id: str,
    tag: str = "RU-VPN"
) -> str:
    params = {
        'encryption': 'none',
        'flow': 'xtls-rprx-vision',
        'security': 'reality',
        'sni': sni,
        'fp': 'chrome',
        'pbk': public_key,
        'sid': short_id,
        'type': 'xhttp',
        'path': '/',
        'mode': 'auto'
    }

    return f"vless://{uuid}@{server}:{port}?{query}#{tag}"

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from typing import Callable, Dict, Any, Awaitable

class DatabaseSessionMiddleware(BaseMiddleware):
    def __init__(self, session_maker):
        self.session_maker = session_maker
    
    async def __call__(
        self,
        handler: Callable[[Message | CallbackQuery, Dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[Any]],
        event: Message | CallbackQuery,
        data: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Any:
        async with self.session_maker() as session:
            data['session'] = session
            return await handler(event, data)

from aiogram import BaseMiddleware
from aiogram.types import Message, CallbackQuery
from typing import Callable, Dict, Any, Awaitable
import os

class AdminMiddleware(BaseMiddleware):
    def __init__(self):
        self.admin_ids = set(map(int, os.getenv("ADMIN_TELEGRAM_ID", "").split(",")))
    
    async def __call__(
        self,
        handler: Callable[[Message | CallbackQuery, Dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[Any]],
        event: Message | CallbackQuery,
        data: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Any:
        user_id = event.from_user.id
        
        if user_id not in self.admin_ids:
            await event.answer("❌ Доступ запрещён")
            return
        
        return await handler(event, data)
